army_rule_description: At the start of your Command phase, select one enemy unit. Until the start of your next Command phase, each time an ADEPTUS ASTARTES model from your army makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

detachments.detachment_rule_description: Once per battle, at the start of your Command phase, when you select a target for Oath of Moment, you can use this Detachment rule. If you do, until the start of your next Command phase, each time an ADEPTUS ASTARTES model from your army makes an attack that targets your Oath of Moment target, you can re-roll the Wound roll.

enhancements.name: Seal of Indomitability
enhancements.description: Once per battle, when the bearer's unit is selected as the target of one or more attacks, it can use this Enhancement. If it does, until the end of the phase, the bearer has a 3+ invulnerable save.

enhancements.name: Resolute
enhancements.description: The bearer is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back. Desperate Escape tests taken for the bearer are automatically passed. Each time the bearer makes a Fall Back move, it can move through enemy models as if they were not there.

stratagems.name: Tower of Strength
stratagems.timing: Start or end of any phase.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES TERMINATOR unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of your next Command phase, add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of models in your unit. Each time you use this Stratagem, you cannot use it again until after your next Command phase.

stratagems.name: Focusing Shrine
stratagems.timing: Your Movement phase, at the start of the Reinforcements step.
stratagems.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES TERMINATOR unit from your army that is in Reserves.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, when setting up your unit using its Deep Strike ability, you can set it up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy models, measuring as normal for Deep Strike but ignoring Walls and closed Hatchways. Until the end of the turn, your unit is not eligible to declare a charge.

stratagems.name: Carve a Path
stratagems.target: One Terminator Assault Squad unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase and has not declared a charge this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, when making a Normal, Advance or Charge move, your unit can move through a single closed Hatchway as if it was open. When doing so, that Hatchway is opened and cannot be closed for the rest of the battle. This can allow that unit to declare a charge against enemy units that are not visible to it, but to do so those enemy units must be within 1" of that Hatchway and wholly on the opposite side of it from your unit. You cannot use this Stratagem more than once per turn.

stratagems.name: Cleansing Sweep
stratagems.timing: Your opponent's Movement or Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One Terminator Squad unit from your army that has not fired Overwatch this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack while firing Overwatch, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ is required to score a hit, instead of an unmodified 6.

mustering_rules.description: All ADEPTUS ASTARTES models in your Boarding Patrol must be drawn from the same Chapter.
You can include up to two of the listed character units (duplicates are not allowed).
You can include up to two of each listed Terminator unit.
Terminator Assault Squad and Terminator Squad units can perform the Secure Site Tactical Manoeuvre as if they had the BATTLELINE keyword.
All units with the Teleport Homer ability lose it.
Arjac Rockfist loses Champion of the Kingsguard.
Logan Grimnar loses The Great Wolf.
Wolf Guard unit loses Chosen Companions.
Wolf Guard Pack Leader in Terminator Armour loses Pack Leader.
